mechanism_builds.causal_path: Higher resting parasympathetic tone (greater RMSSD) → smaller stress‑evoked decrease in RMSSD (ΔRMSSD) → lower signal‑to‑noise ratio for stress features → increased model prediction uncertainty.
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Positive (higher resting RMSSD associated with higher uncertainty)
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Seated baseline ≥5 min and standardized psychosocial stress task (e.g., TSST)
PPG sampled at ≥64 Hz with motion artifact removed
Age 18‑45, no cardiovascular medication
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Assumes linear relationship between RMSSD and uncertainty; can be tested with mixed‑effects regression.

mechanism_builds.causal_path: Higher skin impedance → reduced PPG AC amplitude and increased noise → lower SNR → degraded feature quality → increased model uncertainty.
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Ambient temperature 20‑25°C
Skin cleaned with alcohol, strap pressure standardized
Measurement during rest and mild stress, sampling ≥100 Hz
No tattoos or calluses at sensor site
measurable_outcomes: Predictive variance from Bayesian neural net
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Impedance can be measured via the same device's electrodes; effect expected to be larger in dry‑electrode designs.

mechanism_builds.causal_path: Misalignment between clock time and individual circadian phase (phase difference) → attenuated stress‑evoked physiological response → lower feature discriminability → increased model uncertainty.
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Positive (larger absolute phase difference → higher uncertainty)
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Stable sleep‑wake schedule ≥3 days prior
Circadian phase assessed via melatonin onset (DLMO) or core body temperature
Measurements in dim light, no caffeine/alcohol 2 h prior
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Actigraphy can provide a proxy for phase when melatonin assay unavailable.

mechanism_builds.causal_path: Higher subject‑specific self‑report bias → increased label noise in training data → poorer learned decision boundary → higher prediction uncertainty for that subject.
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: EMA prompts 6×/day for 2 weeks
Physiological ground truth from validated stress induction (e.g., cold pressor)
Wearable data synchronized with EMA, compliance >80%
Participants fluent in EMA language
measurable_outcomes: Estimated label noise (disagreement between EMA and physiology)
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Bias can be quantified as intraclass correlation coefficient between EMA and physiological stress indices.

mechanism_builds.causal_path: Looser strap → lower coupling force → higher motion‑induced artifacts → decreased PPG SNR → degraded features → increased model uncertainty.
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Standardized walking protocol (6‑min walk test) and seated rest
Strap tightness measured in real‑time
Ambient temperature 22 °C, no lotion on skin
Fixed device firmware version
measurable_outcomes: Classification accuracy during walk vs rest
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Tightness can also be inferred from PPG amplitude variability if force sensor unavailable.

mechanism_builds.causal_path: Val allele → higher COMT activity → faster catecholamine clearance → smaller physiological stress response (blunted ΔRMSSD) → reduced signal amplitude → increased model uncertainty.
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Positive dose‑response (more Val alleles → higher uncertainty)
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Abstinence from nicotine, caffeine, alcohol 12 h prior
Stress task: mental arithmetic or TSST
Genotyping via saliva
Age 18‑45, no psychiatric medication
ECG/PPG sampled ≥256 Hz
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Effect size may be modest; large N (>200) recommended for adequate power.

mechanism_builds.causal_path: Repeated exposure → habituation or sensitization → drift in true stress‑signal relationship → model trained on early sessions misfits later data → increased uncertainty.
mechanism_builds.expected_direction: Positive (greater absolute change in stress‑response slope across sessions → higher uncertainty)
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Longitudinal study ≥8 weeks, weekly lab session with standardized stressor
Wearable worn continuously, compliance >90%
No major life events or medication changes
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Can be tested by comparing uncertainty trends in models with vs without session‑specific bias terms.

mechanism_builds.causal_path: Higher activity exposure → greater overlap of activity‑induced physiological changes (HRV, skin conductance) with stress signals → when model ignores activity context, feature ambiguity ↑ → uncertainty ↑.
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Free‑living monitoring 7 days, accelerometer 30 Hz
Activity classification validated against VO₂submax
Stress labels from EMA synchronized with wearable
No extreme exercise (>90% HRmax) during labeling periods
measurable_outcomes: Stress detection AUC stratified by activity level
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Including activity as a covariate should reduce uncertainty if the hypothesis holds.

domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Same regularized logistic regression hyperparameters for all subjects
Labels from validated stress inductions
Minimum 5 labeled samples per subject for feasibility
Leave‑one‑out cross‑validation within subject
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Can be confirmed by simulation: subsampling labels and measuring resulting uncertainty.

mechanism_variables: sampling rate jitter (SD of inter‑sample interval, ms)
synchronization offset between PPG and accelerometer (ms)
mechanism_builds.causal_path: Greater sampling jitter & sync offset → temporal misalignment of multimodal features → degraded feature representation → increased model uncertainty.
domain_specific_boundary_conditions: Device firmware logs timestamps with µs resolution
Bench test with known periodic signal to quantify jitter
Participants wear device during controlled task (e.g., paced breathing)
Ambient temperature 20‑25 °C, no firmware updates during study
mechanism_builds.mechanism_builder_notes: Standard interpolation reduces but does not eliminate jitter; residual misalignment can be modeled as additional noise term.
